• The login and logout process was successfully executed with no errors.
• A clear workflow for generating Crystal Reports was identified.
• Reporting endpoints showed high call frequency, indicating potential inefficiencies.
• No failed endpoints were detected, suggesting stable API performance.
• Recommendations include documenting workflows and investigating caching strategies for reporting.
• Overall, the system appears to be functioning well with identified areas for potential optimization.
